_what: Runtime Virtual Texturing on the look rig (research/rvt_lookdev_design.md, stage B). Built by scripts/make_rvt.py: find-or-create the RVT assets, find-or-spawn one RuntimeVirtualTextureVolume per RVT (by actor TAG), set each volume's transform by hand (SetBounds is C++ only: location = min corner, scale = size in cm), assign the RVTs to the landscape parent (propagates to the streaming proxies), save, read everything back.
_main_pass: Landscape virtual_texture_render_pass_type (LandscapeProxy.h:663): ALWAYS = the landscape still draws its own main pass; stage D (main pass from RVT) is dropped on the rig.
